en: Awe inspiring, master. Your ineptitude is awe inspiring.
ROARRRRR!!
Stormwind's desertion shall not be forgiven by the people of Westfall.
You got me good boss!  How you get by Slip'kik??  I smart though, I watch next time!  Har har!$B$BNobody get by Slip'kik no more. Slip'kik promise!
What can you tell me about the bear - Ursangous?
If you have the time, Grimclaw and his master Volcor could use your help. If you're interested, speak with me further...
Ah, just in time for your cleansing, $r. I shall wax the impurities from your soul.

I doubt you have had much occasion to see such a creature. These demonic equines will make your travels much faster by acting as your mount as long as you control them. However, they are difficult to control, so be sure you are ready before attempting it.
WOOT! Made it!
Whirlaxis!  I hold your scepter!  I command you to enter this world!

The finest preservative of flesh known to man and Scourge alike - Frostwhisper's embalming fluid.  Only one place an adventurer could find this and one would think that the lich the fluid is named after would not take too kindly to anyone going to said place.$B$BBut... if it's the fluid you want, the Scholomance you'll haunt...
Should you choose to follow me, be on guard. The animals and beasts of the Darkshore will not harm me but they may attempt to harm you, adventurer.
After the firework show, they'll put out goblets so we can raise a toast!
Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?
About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!
Thanks for your patience, $n.
The High Priestess could not leave Darnassus. Fandral is in a very foul mood.
%s looks at you expectantly.
Greetings. What business have you with the Carevin family? Do you seek to assist the Carevins in their battle against the undead?
HAVE YOU RUN OUT OF SHIPS TO SEND?  WHERE'S YOUR COURAGE?
The Light protect you, $c.
What bug comes before the lords of the Council?  A bug, no doubt, wishing to be squashed!
So, off to see Myolor, eh? He's right o'er there... behind ye! Er, maybe in front of ye! Near the Great Anvil!
Oh hi! My name's Sarah. What can I do for you?
Tell me about mines.
I've got all the cooking supplies you'll ever need, mon!
You've made the right decision, $c.  You'll find our battlemaster, Glordrum Steelbeard, in the Hall of Arms.  Good luck, $n!
The Light of Elune shine upon thee, $n!  You will find Aethalas, our battlemaster, on the Warrior's Terrace.  She will aid you on your way to Warsong Gulch.
It appears the winds have brought you my way! I am happy to train you in the ways of cooking if you have the inclination to learn.
The Inn
The inn
The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?
Stop pulling her hair out!
Greetings, mortals!  I have been activated by the Discs of Norgannon to assist you!

Just thinking. It's scary out here these days, you know? Any minute this section of the island could drop out from under me and I'd go tumbling... somewhere? Tell me, do you even know what happens to $r who fall off the island?

Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...
Long is the way, and hard, the road you have traveled. Few reach such status amongst our ranks. You are a great friend of the Zandalar empire, $n.$B$BLegendary perhaps... Yes... Perhaps.
You must save him!
Who dares interfere with the business of the Defias Brotherhood?  Die $C!
%s mixes the Bathran's Hair...
I have lost my Drape of Unyielding Strength. Are you able to replace it for me?
